audit_scope.description: Batch 6 covers KZG point evaluation precompile (EIP-4844), PREVRANDAO opcode (EIP-4399), network upgrade meta-EIP (EIP-7773), EL withdrawal requests (EIP-7002), and difficulty bomb delay (EIP-5133). Key boundary is EL-CL interaction via Engine API for RANDAO and withdrawal requests.

in_scope: RANDAO mix provision to EL via block header mixHash
Withdrawal request processing from EL execution payload

misclassified_entities.reason: Calling Contract in point_evaluation.py is internal EL entity (smart contract), not external to the system. The actual external entity is the user submitting the transaction that triggers the precompile call.

trusted_external_entities.name: Consensus Layer via Engine API (RANDAO)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: Engine API (ExecutionPayload.prevRandao field in block header)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated channel with JWT-based Engine API authentication. However, RANDAO content must still be validated: value > 2^64 indicates PoS (vs PoW difficulty), but proposer can bias by 1 bit per slot by choosing to skip. Not suitable for applications requiring unpredictable randomness without additional commit-reveal scheme with multi-epoch delay.

trusted_external_entities.name: User via JSON-RPC (Withdrawal Requests)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: JSON-RPC API (transaction to withdrawal request predeploy 0x00A961Ef480Eb55e80D19ad83579A64c007002)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated RPC endpoint. Withdrawal request must be validated: (1) Input exactly 56 bytes (48-byte validator pubkey + 8-byte amount), (2) msg.value ≥ current dynamic fee (EIP-1559-style exponential pricing, minimum 1 wei), (3) Request queued in predeploy state. Final authorization check performed by CL: msg.sender must match validator's 0x01 withdrawal credentials.

trusted_external_entities.name: User via JSON-RPC (Blob Transaction with KZG Proof)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: JSON-RPC API (blob transaction with versioned_hashes requiring KZG verification)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated RPC endpoint. When contract calls point_evaluation precompile (0x0A) to verify blob commitment, precompile validates: (1) Input exactly 192 bytes (32 versioned_hash + 32 z + 32 y + 48 commitment + 48 proof), (2) Versioned hash matches kzg_commitment_to_versioned_hash(commitment) with version 0x01, (3) KZG proof verifies: polynomial(z) = y using BLS12-381 pairing check. Rejects with KZGProofError if invalid. Security relies on trusted setup (powers of tau ceremony).

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Engine API authentication: JWT token in Authorization header, shared secret established at client startup. RANDAO value validation: (1) Post-merge blocks: prevRandao > 2^64 (heuristic check), (2) Value sourced from CL beacon state's randao_mixes, (3) EVM PREVRANDAO (0x44) opcode returns this value. Smart contracts using PREVRANDAO must understand biasability: proposer has 1-bit influence per slot (can skip slot to bias outcome), approximately 4 epochs of lookahead. Not suitable for immediate unpredictable randomness.

EL validation: (1) Empty calldata returns current fee (no-op query), (2) 56-byte calldata triggers withdrawal request: validate length, charge dynamic fee (exponential based on excess requests vs TARGET_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTS_PER_BLOCK=2), enqueue with msg.sender as source_address. (3) Post-block system call dequeues up to MAX_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTS_PER_BLOCK=16 into ExecutionPayload. CL validation: source_address must match validator's withdrawal credentials (0x01 prefix + address). CL processes as voluntary exit or partial withdrawal.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Point evaluation precompile (0x0A) via contract CALL/STATICCALL
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Input validation: exactly 192 bytes, parse as (versioned_hash[32], z[32], y[32], commitment[48], proof[48]). Versioned hash check: compute kzg_commitment_to_versioned_hash(commitment) = SHA256(0x01 || commitment)[0:32], verify equals input versioned_hash. KZG proof verification: verify_kzg_proof(commitment, z, y, proof) using BLS12-381 pairing check, confirms polynomial(z)=y for committed polynomial. Gas cost: fixed 50,000 gas (GAS_POINT_EVALUATION). Security: assumes KZG trusted setup ceremony completed correctly and toxic waste destroyed. Failure returns KZGProofError, call reverts.
